Q5460.reason: The painter’s statement blaming coworkers for a structural failure he did not participate in is hearsay and not a vicarious admission of the employer, so the objection is sustained.

Q8222.reason: Fever, cold symptoms, and a sharp rise in creatinine six weeks after a kidney transplant fit adenovirus infection of the allograft mimicking rejection.

Q5849.reason: His testimony that he kept the records in the regular course of business authenticates them and satisfies the business-records exception, so the court admits them.
